riskNotes.note: 0.1.3: an agent-supplied `config` whose `extends` names an absolute path to a JS file executed that file in the server process (confirmed by the owner 2026-10-19). Fixed in 0.1.4: `extends` may name only built-in `solhint:*` presets and `plugins` are rejected. Reproduced 2026-10-23 with a benign marker file: 0.1.3 ran it, 0.1.4 refused the call.

Linting a repository runs that repository's own Solhint plugins and JS config (.solhint.json plugins, .solhintrc.js, solhint.config.js, a project-installed Solhint): the same trust as running `npx solhint` there. No version of this component changes that; it is not safe for untrusted repositories.
C4: a Solhint plugin that fails to load is only warned about, so a lint can look clean while that plugin's rules never ran (documented by the owner).
